verdict.rationale: A third-party UI component library ecosystem is a fair question for a React framework like Next.js, so the axis applies, but no evidence item documents one. The closest items cover styling tools ('popular community libraries' for CSS) and pre-built templates/solutions, which are adjacent features rather than UI component libraries. Being a React framework (a host-platform trait) earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pick from a rich ecosystem of third-party pre-built UI component libraries for the framework
